Protocol evidence fixes the QC-LDPC matrix identity: BG, Zc, lifting set and shift tables. RTL choices such as layered order, CN lane count, memory banking, stall policy, NMS/OMS constants and early-stop timing are implementation strategy and
must be closed by bit-exact checkpoint traces.
